//: VS Code: put this in .vscode/mcp.json. `inputs` keeps the password out of the file — VS Code asks for it once and stores it in its own secret store, which is the point.

inputs.description: Password for the read-only PostgreSQL role

//sslmode: No sslmode here on purpose. A local PostgreSQL ships with ssl=off — the official Docker image and the distribution packages all do — so `sslmode=verify-full` against localhost fails at the handshake. This example carried it until 2026-08-17 and therefore did not work as written. For a hosted database (RDS, Supabase, Neon) add `?sslmode=verify-full` and point MCP_SSLROOTCERT at the provider CA bundle.
